request_modes: captured loader; target browser|bun|node; define; tsconfig; macro map; export rewrite; trimming; minification/inlining
result_contract: Reusable JavaScript object exposing transform, transformSync, scan, and scanImports.
failure_contract: Construction throws provider-native option/initialization errors; diagnostic stability is not certified.
ownership_contract: Caller retains the JavaScript object; Bun declares no dispose method.
cancellation_contract: No cancellation concept applies to construction.
retained_result_contract: GC timing and release of native backing state are undocumented and untested.
recommendation_basis: Preserves reusable captured configuration without pretending the object is an explicitly scoped native resource.

request_modes: string|Uint8Array; optional loader override; captured Transpiler options
result_contract: Promise<string> containing transformed JavaScript; modules are not resolved or executed.
failure_contract: Promise rejects or throws provider-native parse/configuration errors.
ownership_contract: Returned string is caller-owned; provider work is documented on Bun's worker threadpool.
cancellation_contract: No AbortSignal or supported cancellation handle; Effect interruption cannot mean provider cancellation.
retained_result_contract: Ordinary JavaScript value retention; macro-created runtime state is not characterized.
recommendation_basis: Async scheduling and interruption semantics differ from transformSync.

request_modes: string|Uint8Array; optional loader override; captured Transpiler options
result_contract: string containing transformed JavaScript; modules are not resolved or executed.
ownership_contract: Returned string is caller-owned; work runs on the calling thread.
cancellation_contract: Synchronous execution is not cooperatively interruptible through Effect while running.
retained_result_contract: Ordinary JavaScript value retention; macro side effects remain provider authority.
recommendation_basis: A truthful provider primitive that must not be hidden behind the async identity.

result_contract: Object with exports:string[] and imports:{path,kind}[]; type-only imports/exports are ignored.
ownership_contract: Returned arrays and records are caller-owned JavaScript values.
cancellation_contract: No cancellation handle is declared; bounded latency is not documented.
retained_result_contract: Ordinary JavaScript value retention; no filesystem graph is retained.
recommendation_basis: Scanning is a first-class native operation rather than a reduced bundle result.

result_contract: Array of {path,kind}; documented as faster but marginally less accurate than scan.
ownership_contract: Returned array and records are caller-owned JavaScript values.
cancellation_contract: No cancellation handle is declared; bounded latency is not documented.
retained_result_contract: Ordinary JavaScript value retention; no filesystem graph is retained.
recommendation_basis: Its explicit performance/accuracy tradeoff makes it a distinct operation.

public_surface: Bun.build(config) without outdir and without a direct-write compile mode
request_modes: disk|virtual|mixed graph; browser|bun|node; JS/CSS/HTML; plugins/loaders; externals; chunks; assets; maps; metafile; bytecode sidecar where valid
result_contract: Promise<BuildOutput> with outputs:BuildArtifact[], success, logs, and optional metafile; BuildArtifact extends Blob.
failure_contract: throw:true rejects with AggregateError; throw:false resolves success:false. Partial-result behavior is untested.
ownership_contract: BuildOutput/BuildArtifact wrappers are caller-retained; callbacks execute with host authority.
cancellation_contract: No AbortSignal/cancel method; Effect interruption can only stop waiting unless execution proves more.
retained_result_contract: Artifact readability after delayed retention, GC, plugin teardown, or provider shutdown is unknown.
publication_contract: No Bun-directed durable publication; later writes are separate caller mutations.
recommendation_basis: Raw native request/result types preserve Bun's graph and metadata without invented publication or cancellation guarantees.

public_surface: Bun.build(config) with outdir or another documented direct-write build mode
request_modes: same graph/configuration breadth as OP-BUN-006 with explicit provider output destination
result_contract: Promise<BuildOutput>; output paths identify provider-written HTML, JS, CSS, chunks, assets, maps, bytecode, or metadata by mode.
failure_contract: Default throw behavior; atomicity, rollback, pre-existing-output interaction, and partial failure topology are unknown.
ownership_contract: Returned metadata is caller-retained; files are durable provider writes outside an Effect scope.
cancellation_contract: No supported cancellation handle; interruption/remnant behavior is unknown.
retained_result_contract: Artifacts were immediately readable in exact receipts; long retention is untested.
publication_contract: Provider-direct durable publication; never call it atomic replacement.
recommendation_basis: Direct durable publication changes failure and ownership obligations and therefore semantic identity.

public_surface: selected bun build command with stdout transport and no durable output destination
request_modes: selected executable; argv/cwd/env; serializable CLI options only; no callback/virtual-file parity
result_contract: Exit status and raw stdout/stderr; tagged docs demonstrate finite stdout bundle transport for a single-output case.
failure_contract: Non-zero exit and raw human diagnostics; no stable machine diagnostic protocol.
ownership_contract: Command scope owns process; collected bytes can be caller values after exit.
cancellation_contract: Child signaling exists; exact signal-to-provider behavior is untested.
retained_result_contract: Captured bytes are stable after collection; provider BuildArtifact objects are unavailable.
publication_contract: No provider output publication in stdout mode.
recommendation_basis: Truthful raw command primitive that must not be advertised as host-API parity.

public_surface: selected bun build command with outfile/outdir
request_modes: selected executable; argv/cwd/env; serializable graph options; browser|bun|node
result_contract: Exit status, raw stdout/stderr, and provider-written output topology; optional CLI metafile.
failure_contract: Non-zero exit and human diagnostics; partial writes, replacement, and remnants are unknown.
ownership_contract: Command-scoped process; written files remain durable after exit.
cancellation_contract: Child signaling exists; interruption-to-cleanup behavior is untested.
retained_result_contract: Captured bytes persist; outputs are durable files.
publication_contract: Provider-direct durable publication; no atomicity claim.
recommendation_basis: Retains CLI/project/executable authority and cannot be collapsed into Bun.build.

request_modes: serializable CLI build options plus --watch; disk graph; raw process environment
result_contract: Owned child handle with byte streams and repeated provider writes; no typed readiness/rebuild protocol.
failure_contract: Raw diagnostics and process exit/signal; per-rebuild recovery is not a machine contract.
ownership_contract: Effect scope owns the child; Bun outputs remain durable absent explicit cleanup.
cancellation_contract: Wrapper may signal the child; subtree termination, in-flight cancellation, and cleanup are unknown.
retained_result_contract: Live streams are scope-borrowed; copied observations may be retained; files are durable.
publication_contract: Repeated provider-direct durable publication with unknown replacement/remnant semantics.
recommendation_basis: Expose an opaque provider-named scoped process with raw streams; reject invented typed events.

request_modes: plain or full-stack entry; embedded files/workers; target tuple; autoload policy; bytecode; Windows metadata; implicit|explicit outfile
result_contract: BuildOutput identifying executable entry-point and documented companions; executable embeds Bun runtime.
failure_contract: AggregateError/default throw; cross-target acquisition, partial writes, and cleanup on failure/interruption are unknown.
ownership_contract: Returned metadata is caller-retained; executable and target-runtime cache mutations are durable.
cancellation_contract: No cancellation handle; Effect interruption does not establish provider cancellation.
retained_result_contract: Executable is durable; BuildArtifact retention beyond settlement is untested.
publication_contract: Provider-direct durable executable publication; no atomic replacement claim.
recommendation_basis: Provider-named BunRuntimeExecutable operation must retain runtime/target/acquisition identity.

request_modes: selected executable; single entry; target tuple; full-stack; embedded files/workers; bytecode; autoload policy
result_contract: Exit status, raw streams, and durable Bun executable topology.
failure_contract: Non-zero exit and human diagnostics; acquisition, partial writes, and remnants are unknown.
ownership_contract: Command scope owns process; executable/cache mutation are durable.
cancellation_contract: Child signaling exists; provider cleanup is unknown.
retained_result_contract: Captured process result persists; executable is durable.
publication_contract: Provider-direct durable executable publication; no atomic replacement claim.
recommendation_basis: Preserve current command operation and widen only through explicit fields and exact gates.

public_surface: effect-build compileExecutable staging/commit wrapper over selected bun build --compile
request_modes: current effect-build target/options subset; selected executable; effect-build-owned staging
result_contract: effect-build Executable artifact with Bun provenance after successful commit.
failure_contract: Typed command/validation/publication failures; rollback is limited to current single-file implementation.
ownership_contract: Effect scope owns staging; committed executable is durable.
cancellation_contract: Interruption follows command runner; provider cancellation/cleanup remains uncertified.
retained_result_contract: Committed executable is durable; staging is scope-owned.
publication_contract: Atomic-published durable only for the current single-file wrapper.
recommendation_basis: Existing authorized identity; does not generalize atomicity to all Bun output trees.

result_contract: ReturnType of setup, usually void|Promise<void>; future builds/runtime imports observe registration.
failure_contract: Provider callback/setup failures; ordering and concurrent-build interaction uncertified.
ownership_contract: Runtime-global mutation; no scoped registration handle.
cancellation_contract: No cancellation protocol; setup may be async but lifetime is ambient.
retained_result_contract: Persists until clearAll or runtime termination; concurrency visibility unknown.
recommendation_basis: Would legitimize ambient mutable authority without a scoped ownership invariant.

result_contract: void; declarations say future builds stop applying registered plugins.
failure_contract: No structured failure contract; active/concurrent-build races are untested.
ownership_contract: Global mutation has no request owner or returned handle.
retained_result_contract: Effects on already-started callbacks/builds are unknown.
recommendation_basis: Global clear cannot be made scope-safe by a thin wrapper.
